english.title: Induce the commission of an offence relating to the safety of a ship / cargo / sea platform outside UK
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) induced the commission outside the United Kingdom of an act of

(A)_[hijacking a ship, namely **(..SPECIFY SHIP..),]_
(B)_[destroying a ship, namely **(..SPECIFY SHIP..),]_
(C)_[destroying a fixed platform, namely **(..FIXED PLATFORM..),]_
(D)_[damaging a ship, namely **(..SPECIFY SHIP..), so as to endanger, or be likely to endanger its safe navigation]_
(E)_[damaging the cargo of a ship, namely **(..SPECIFY SHIP..), so as to endanger, or be likely to endanger its safe navigation]_
(F)_[damaging a fixed platform, namely **(..FIXED PLATFORM..), so as to endanger the safety of the platform]_
(G)_[committing an act of violence on board a ship, namely **(..SPECIFY SHIP..), which was likely to endanger the safe navigation of the ship]_
(H)_[committing an act of violence on board a fixed platform, namely **(..SPECIFY FIXED PLATFORM..), which was likely to endanger the safe navigation of the ship]_
(I)_[unlawfully and intentionally destroying or damaging property, namely **(..SPECIFY PROPERTY..),]_
(J)_[unlawfully, intentionally and seriously interfering with the operation of property, namely **(..SPECIFY PROPERTY..),]_
(K)_[making a threat]_

which would have been an offence under **(..SPECIFY SECTION..) of the Aviation and Maritime Security Act 1990
english.legislation: Contrary to section 14(4) and (5) of the Aviation and Maritime Security Act 1990.

english.notes: Terrorist connection - this offence is listed in Schedule 1 to the Sentencing Act 2020. Where the court has determined that there is a terrorist connection, the court has to treat this as an aggravating factor in sentencing (section 69 of that Act) and the notification requirements under the Counter-Terrorism Act 2008 apply (section 42 of that Act). In addition, section 23A of the Terrorism Act 2000 provides for forfeiture of money or other property.

libra.complexpenaltydetails: Life Imprisonment. The Crown Court may also impose a fine where no specific provision is made to do so (Section 163 Criminal Justice Act 2003).
